work.label: 01 — Selected Work
work.title: Systems in Active Production.
work.subtitle: Strategic games, intelligent utilities, and experimental prototypes.
work.komboTagline: Tactical Drafting, Card Evolution & Elemental Synergies
work.komboDescription: A focused mobile auto-battler card game built around high-consequence drafting, elemental resonance, and spatial card positioning. Few cards, many decisions.
work.kalanlaTagline: Zero-Waste Culinary Intelligence & Pantry Inventory Engine
work.kalanlaDescription: Input what is left in your pantry or scan your fridge; the deterministic algorithm pairs ingredients, prevents food waste, and serves an optimized rescue recipe.
work.protocolDescription: An exploratory narrative simulation studying systemic collapse, procedural mechanics, and moral friction. Maintained in the incubator stage until core systems mature.

thesis.label: 02 — Studio Thesis
thesis.title: Different Outputs. One Discipline.
thesis.subtitle: We forge digital artifacts with intentional architecture and patience.
thesis.t1Text: Eye candy degrades quickly without solid underlying mathematics. We build robust loops, determinism, and data structures before polishing the surface.
thesis.t2Text: No design survives first contact with reality unchanged. We deploy early test builds, gather ground-truth telemetry, and refine relentlessly.
thesis.t3Text: We reject ephemeral trends and hype cycles. Whether a strategy card game or a kitchen utility, our work is engineered to endure and respect user agency.
thesis.originText: Rynia began in 2019 as a personal handle and evolved into a disciplined independent atelier. Bearing this mark is a reminder never to abandon an unfinished craft—to build patiently, layer by layer.
